article.title: 4 [Construction of certain references to Act 15 of 1877 and Act 9 of 1871.
article.content:
34[Construction of certain references to Act 15 of 1877 and Act 9 of 1871.

Section 3  ·  Preliminary  ·  page 4 of the Act
All references in any Act or Regulation to sections 26 and 27 of the Indian Limitation Act, 1877 or5 to sections 27 and 28 of Act No. 9 of 1871 shall6, in the territories to which this Act extends, be read as made to sections 15 and 16 of this Act.]
4 Subs. by Act 10 of 1914, s. 2 and the First Schedule, for s. 3.
5 See now the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963).
6 Rep. by Act 15 of 1877.
